html:
Lithuania is a country on the south-east shore of the Baltic. The map shows the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1279 and 1300, and the modern republic from 1920 to 2010.

It was the one people among the Baltic tribes that built a strong state of its own. Mindaugas united the Lithuanians and was crowned king in 1253. Gediminas, from 1316 to 1341, founded the dynasty and made Vilnius his capital. Lithuania stayed pagan, fought off the Teutonic Knights and expanded east over the Rus lands until it reached the Black Sea.

In 1385 Grand Duke Jogaila married the queen of Poland, and two years later Lithuania was baptised. Together Poland and Lithuania beat the knights at the Battle of Grunwald in 1410. The two became one state, Poland-Lithuania, until Russia took Lithuania in 1795.

Independent again from 1918 to 1940, it was then seized by the Soviet Union. In March 1990 it was the first Soviet republic to declare independence, a step toward the end of the Soviet Union.
sum: Lithuania is a country on the south-east shore of the Baltic. The map shows the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1279 and 1300, and the modern republic from 1920 to 2010.
